visual_elements:
This diagram compares two civil rights organizations.

Southern Christian Leadership Conference (SCLC)
• Founded by Martin Luther King, Jr. in 1957
• Used the Citizenship Education Program (CEP) to help African Americans register to vote

Black Panthers
• Founded by Bobby Seale and Huey P. Newton in 1966
• ?

Both:
• Focused on obtaining civil rights
